description: This file contains a unit test class 'ForYouViewModelTest' for testing the 'ForYouViewModel' in an Android app. It verifies various UI states, topic and news resource selection behaviors, deep linking, and other interactions within the ViewModel.

classes.name: ForYouViewModelTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ForYouViewModel, containing multiple test methods that verify UI states, data flows, interactions, and deep link handling within the ViewModel.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel before each test by injecting dependencies.

methods.name: stateIsInitiallyLoading
methods.description: Verifies that upon initialization, the onboarding and feed UI states are set to Loading.

methods.name: stateIsLoadingWhenFollowedTopicsAreLoading
methods.description: Checks that the ViewModel maintains a Loading state when followable topics are still loading.

methods.name: stateIsLoadingWhenAppIsSyncingWithNoInterests
methods.description: Ensures that the syncing state is reflected in isSyncing when app sync is active but no interests are selected.

methods.name: onboardingStateIsLoadingWhenTopicsAreLoading
methods.description: Verifies onboarding UI state remains Loading when topics are loading and user interests are empty.

methods.name: onboardingIsShownWhenNewsResourcesAreLoading
methods.description: Checks that onboarding is shown with unselected topics while news resources are loading.

methods.name: onboardingIsShownAfterLoadingEmptyFollowedTopics
methods.description: Verifies onboarding appears with topics when a user has not followed any topics but news resources are loaded.

methods.name: onboardingIsNotShownAfterUserDismissesOnboarding
methods.description: Ensures that once the user dismisses onboarding, it is not shown again and news feed updates accordingly.

methods.name: topicSelectionUpdatesAfterSelectingTopic
methods.description: Tests that selecting a topic updates the FollowedTopics and refreshes the news feed.

methods.name: topicSelectionUpdatesAfterUnselectingTopic
methods.description: Verifies that unselecting a topic updates the FollowedTopics and resets the feed appropriately.

methods.name: newsResourceSelectionUpdatesAfterLoadingFollowedTopics
methods.description: Checks that saving a news resource updates the bookmarked state and reflects in the feed.

methods.name: deepLinkedNewsResourceIsFetchedAndResetAfterViewing
methods.description: Tests that a deep link to a news resource fetches correct data and resets after viewing, and that analytics are logged.

methods.name: whenUpdateNewsResourceSavedIsCalled_bookmarkStateIsUpdated
methods.description: Verifies that updating a news resource's saved status updates the user's bookmarked resources.
